question: Kadana Dam of Gujarat is built over which of the following rivers?
solution: The correct answer is **Mahi** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** • Kadana Dam is an earthen and masonry dam on the Mahi river in the Mahisagar district of Gujarat, India. • The dam was constructed between 1979 and 1989. • The dam supports a pumped-storage hydroelectric power station. • The first two generators commissioned, stage I, are reversible Kaplan turbines that allow the power station to generate electricity during peak hours and then pump it back into the reservoir during low-demand hours such as night. • Kadana Eddy Marking Sedimentary Structures nearby has been declared the National Geological Monuments of India by the Geological Survey Of India, for their protection, maintenance, promotion, and enhancement of geo-tourism.
